recommendation_summary: Set up one externally hosted dead-man's-switch monitor that `nightly-sync` pings only after a successful run, which emails the user if the ping doesn't arrive by the deadline.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker are unnecessary for that outcome.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends its own email, so a startup crash also silences the alert.
labels.Checked myself: From what you told me, cron runs it at 03:00 on `edna`, four startup crashes went unnoticed, and no independent alert exists.

note: The reply recommends a single external heartbeat alert, keeps the Synology out of it, and has all four record lines before the recommendation, each tied to the facts of this case.
